item.description: Part of the problem is there are fewer farmers to sell to, as large farm operations swallow them up, Midwest Co-op general manager Allan Williamson said.

item.title: Hanover police investigating latest shoplifting for link to theft ring
item.description: Police said an 'organized theft ring of professional shoplifters based in the Greater Toronto Area are responsible for almost half a million dollars of stolen merchandise from these franchised pharmacies across Ontario since January of 2025.'
